newsitem.title: USA: Community to buy sports products cos.
newsitem.headline: Community to buy sports products cos.

text.p: Community Redevelopment Corp said Tuesday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire two companies make licensed sports products for stock.

The proposed acquisition, said the company, requires a 1-for-10 reverse split in its common stock, the disposition of its current home remodeling business and operations, and the raising of additional working capital.
Community Redevlopment said its directors have formally approved the required actions, setting the record date of the reverse split as June 20.
A definitive agreement for the acquisition is scheduled to be executed by July 1 with the acquisition to close by Nov 30, subject to customary conditions.
Community Redevelopment had annual sales of more than $2.6 million in fiscal 1996.
